label: Note
raw: bed temperature should be lowered to ambient before removing the printed part to avoid severe deformation
quote: Note: Prior to removing the printed part from the bed, the bed temperature should be lowered to ambient to avoid severe deformation of the part.

label: Build plate adhesion
raw: adhesive promotor, e.g. glue-stick or 3D-Lac®; alternatively bare glass at elevated temperatures with a large footprint (large brim); clean with ethanol or acetone first
quote: For the best adhesion with Arnitel® ID it is advised to use an adhesive promotor, e.g. glue-stick or 3D-Lac®.

label: Brim
quote: It is advised to add a brim of at least 5 mm to the print.

label: STARTUP/SHUT DOWN
raw: extrude at least 50 mm of new filament through the nozzle at start; remove filament before shutting down
quote: Starting the machine, extrude at least 50 mm of new filament through the nozzle.

label: PRODUCTION BREAKS
raw: purge the nozzle adequately during breaks longer than a few minutes
quote: During production breaks longer than a few minutes, purge the nozzle adequately.

label: Troubleshooting
raw: Warping: increase the build plate temperature; first layer not sticking: check bed levelling and first layer thickness, larger brim, raise bed temperature, adhesion promotor or PEI bed substrate; filament grinding: reduce printing speed, disable retraction or reduce retraction speed and length; stringing: lower nozzle temperature, increase travel speed
quote: Stringing: Unwanted strands of plastic span across the print. Lower nozzle temperature, increase travel speed of the print head.
